name: oblique-below-c
airframe: Fighter1, Multirole1, SmallFighter1, trainer, VTOLTrainer1, CAS1, COIN, EW1, FastBomber1, Darkreach
note: CORNER-SPEED TWIN of 'oblique-below' — identical geometry, identical replicate count; the ONLY difference is the entry condition, which is 0.95x each lane airframe's OWN corner speed instead of a flat 250 m/s. That is what lets all ten fixed-wing keys fly one card: at 250 m/s CAS1 and COIN are refused pre-spawn (above 0.95x Vmax) and the roster is 8. 0.95 rather than 1.00 because CAS1's published cornerSpeed (200) is itself above 0.95x its Vmax (195.3). startSpeed 250 is retained as the fail-soft fallback ONLY: if the envelope cannot be read the resolver warns and degrades to exactly the 'oblique-below' condition, a known-good state, rather than to something novel. The same 6 deg oblique diamond as oblique-6, but centred 20 deg BELOW the horizon - the v0.85 elDn regime, entered at small step sizes. elDn is the one segment in the whole corpus where roll and yaw genuinely fight (42.0% of samples commanding opposite signs, against 0-12% everywhere else), and it is also the only one flown deep below the nose. This card separates those two facts: if the cross-fighting follows the BELOWNESS it will show up here at 6 deg steps; if it followed the 20 deg step size it will not. Entry is 6000 m, not 4000: 38 s nose-down at 250 m/s spends ~3.3 km. Its control is its OWN mirror pairs, not oblique-6 (different altitude, and speed builds throughout). AIRFRAME: any jet at the fixedwing-v2 entry condition. CARD-OWNED VALUES (v1.0.3): Drone/DroneAltDeckM = 0 - corpus: this card last flew in R29 (v0.93.0), before Drone/DroneAltDeckM existed (v0.99), so every lane flew one deck.
